headline: Apple's first folding iPhone starts at 1,999 dollars

sources.title: Apple debuts the iPhone Duo, its first foldable, priced at $1,999
Apple Announces iPhone 18, iPhone Duo Foldable Model Price and Availability
Apple event: foldable iPhone Duo revealed

chunks.text: Apple {{showed off}} its first [[folding phone]] on September 9, 2026. The [[device]] is called the iPhone Duo, and it opens like a small book. When it is {{folded up}}, the [[outer]] screen measures 5.4 inches. When the phone {{folds out}}, a larger 7.6-inch screen appears on the inside. The company {{laid out}} the prices and dates at the same event. The Duo [[starts at]] 1,999 dollars. Apple has never sold a folding phone before, so the Duo is a new [[category]] for the company.

verbs.correct: To present something new to the public
verbs.why: A museum shows off a new exhibit to the press, and a car maker shows off a new model at a show. Apple showed off its first folding phone on September 9, 2026.

verbs.correct: To close by bending in half
verbs.why: A camping chair folds up to fit in the trunk, and a letter folds up to fit in an envelope. When the Duo is folded up, the outer screen measures 5.4 inches.

verbs.correct: To open to its full, larger size
verbs.wrong: To connect to a wireless network
verbs.why: A paper map folds out across the table, and a sofa folds out into a bed for guests. The iPhone Duo folds out from a 5.4-inch phone into a 7.6-inch screen.

verbs.correct: To give details in a clear way
verbs.wrong: To end someone's job to save money
verbs.why: A teacher lays out the rules on day one, and a report lays out the costs step by step. Apple laid out the prices and dates for the Duo at the event.

chunks.text: Inside, the Duo runs a new [[chip]]. Apple also {{built in}} a new [[cooling system]] to control heat. The company says the phone {{holds up}} better [[over time]], keeping 35 percent more [[performance]] than the iPhone 17 Pro. [[Battery life]] depends on how the phone is used. On the front screen alone, it can play up to 31 hours of video before the battery {{runs out}}. When both screens are used [[equally]], that [[figure]] drops to 24 hours.

verbs.correct: To include as a part of a product
verbs.why: Car makers build in sensors that watch the road, and a good alarm clock builds in a small light. Apple built in a new cooling system next to the new chip.

verbs.correct: To keep working well as time passes
verbs.wrong: To hide information from the public
verbs.why: Good boots hold up through many winters, and a good coat holds up for many years. Apple says the Duo holds up better over time, with 35 percent more performance than the iPhone 17 Pro.

verbs.wrong: To go past the planned time
verbs.why: Coffee runs out halfway through a long meeting, and tickets run out fast for a popular show. The Duo can play up to 31 hours of video on the front screen before the battery runs out.

chunks.text: On the back, the phone has two [[rear cameras]]. Each one is 48 [[megapixels]]. One is a wide camera, and the other is an [[ultrawide]] camera that captures a wider view. Apple says [[preorders]] {{kick off}} on October 16. The phone then {{comes out}} on October 23, one week later. Both screens can be used, the small one with the phone closed and the large one with it open.

verbs.correct: To start at a planned time
verbs.why: A festival kicks off at noon, and a big sale kicks off on Friday morning. Preorders for the Duo kick off on October 16.
A new game comes out in November, and a novel comes out in paperback a year later. The iPhone Duo comes out on October 23.

chunks.text: The Duo was not the only [[announcement]]. Apple also {{rolled out}} the iPhone 18 Pro at the same event, and new watches {{rounded out}} the [[lineup]]. The event was also the first [[annual]] product event since Apple's new [[chief executive]] {{took over}}. The company holds this event every year, and this was the first time the new leader ran it. For Apple, the Duo is a new kind of iPhone, with two screens instead of one.

verbs.wrong: To return to an earlier version
verbs.why: A bank rolls out a new savings app, and a restaurant chain rolls out a winter menu. Apple also rolled out the iPhone 18 Pro at the same event.

verbs.correct: To complete a group of things
verbs.wrong: To gather a group in one place
verbs.why: A dessert rounds out a good dinner, and two young players round out a team. New watches rounded out the lineup at Apple's event.

verbs.wrong: To hire new workers for a job
verbs.why: A new manager takes over a store, and a daughter takes over the family bakery. This was the first annual product event since Apple's new chief executive took over.

mainIdea.s: Apple showed its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, which starts at 1,999 dollars. It comes out on October 23, at the first event led by the new chief executive.
mainIdea.why: The Duo has a 5.4-inch outer screen and a 7.6-inch inner screen, comes out on October 23, and was shown at the first annual event since Apple's new chief executive took over.

mainIdea.s: Apple showed its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, which starts at 1,999 dollars. It went on sale the same day, at the last event led by the old chief executive.
mainIdea.why: Close, but the phone comes out on October 23, and the event was the first annual product event since Apple's new chief executive took over.

mainIdea.s: Apple canceled its September event after a problem with the new folding screen on a phone. The company said the iPhone Duo would not go on sale until next year.
mainIdea.why: The event took place on September 9, Apple showed the iPhone Duo there, and the phone comes out on October 23.

tf.s: The iPhone Duo folds out to a 7.6-inch screen on the inside.
tf.why: Closed, the outer screen is 5.4 inches, and the phone folds out to a larger 7.6-inch screen inside.

tf.s: Preorders for the Duo kick off on October 23.
tf.why: Preorders kick off on October 16, and the phone comes out one week later, on October 23.

tf.s: Each of the two rear cameras is 48 megapixels.
tf.why: Apple laid out the camera details at the event, with two 48-megapixel rear cameras, one wide and one ultrawide.

tf.s: The Duo plays up to 24 hours of video on the front screen alone.
tf.why: On the front screen alone, the battery runs out after up to 31 hours of video, and 24 hours is the figure when both screens are used equally.

tf.s: It was the first annual product event since Apple's new chief executive took over.
tf.why: Apple holds this event every year, and the September 9 event was the first one that the new chief executive led.

tf.s: Apple says the Duo keeps 35 percent more performance over time than the iPhone 18 Pro.
tf.why: Apple says the Duo holds up better over time than the iPhone 17 Pro, with 35 percent more performance, and the iPhone 18 Pro was a separate announcement.
